caption:
Here a simple way to change your life 

#wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #mindfulness #lifelessons
transcript: Here is a simple way to change your life. And it sounds too small, so people ignore it. Stop being so angry about everything. I am not saying this to shame you. I am saying this to free you. Most people wake up already holding a sword. Before anything even happens, their body is tight, their mind is ready, their heart is braced for attack. When I say, drop the sword, I mean notice how often you are preparing for a fight that never comes. Someone speaks and you grip tighter. Something goes wrong and you sharpen the blade. A small inconvenience appears and suddenly your whole nervous system is at war. You think the sword protects you, but it does not. It only keeps you tired. It keeps you tense. It keeps you unable to enjoy the life God already gave you. Dropping the sword does not mean becoming weak. It means trusting that not everything requires your defense. It means understanding that peace is strength too. Today, pay attention. Notice the moment your shoulders rise. Notice the jaw tighten. Notice the breath shorten. That is the sword in your hand. Put it down. Allow yourself to soften. Allow yourself to breathe. Allow yourself to enjoy one moment without resistance. Turn your attention to the people who love you. The ones who show up quietly. The ones who support you without asking for anything back. Pour your energy there. Return love instead of frustration. Return patience instead of tension. When you stop being angry at everything, you create space. And in that space, joy can enter. Gratitude can enter. God can work without resistance. Life does not become easier, but your heart becomes lighter. And a lighter heart can finally enjoy the life it has been fighting against. If you feel called to go deeper into this practice of letting go, I wrote more reflections like this in my ebook, The Way Back to Stillness. You'll find it waiting for you in the link on my profile.
